message.content:
I’m not able to pull up a list of security guards directly, but I can point you toward some reliable ways to find a reputable, popular guard (or security company) in New York: | What you’re looking for | How to find it | Tips for choosing the best option | |--------------------------|----------------|-----------------------------------| | **Private security guard** (individual) | • Ask local security agencies for a “security guard” recommendation.
• Check online review sites (Google, Yelp, Angi/Angie’s List).
• Look at the agency’s website for staff bios and client testimonials. | • Verify the guard’s license and background check status.
• Ask for references from other clients in the same industry.
• Check that the guard has the right training (e.g., first aid, conflict de‑escalation). | | **Security company** (provides guards on demand) | • Search “security guard services New York City” on Google.
• Use professional directories such as the National Association of Security Companies (NASCO) or the International Association of Professional Security Consultants (IAPSC).
• Read reviews on sites like BBB (Better Business Bureau) and Trustpilot. | • Look for companies that are members of NASCO or IAPSC—they often meet higher standards.
• Ask about their staff turnover rate; low turnover usually means better training and reliability.
• Request a quote and ask for a detailed service agreement. | | **Specialized security guard** (e.g., event security, executive protection) | • Search for “event security services NYC” or “executive protection NYC”.
• Check industry forums (e.g., Event Planning & Management forums) for recommendations.
• Ask local event venues or corporate security departments for referrals. | • Verify that the guard has experience in the specific setting you need (crowd control, VIP protection, etc.).
• Confirm that the company carries appropriate liability insurance. | ### Quick steps to get started 1. **Define your needs** – Do you need a single guard for a home, a guard for a corporate office, or a team for an event? 2. **Search online** – Use the keywords above and filter results by “New York City” or the borough you’re in. 3. **Check credentials** – In New York, private security guards must be licensed by the NY State Department of State. Ask the agency for proof of licensing and background checks. 4. **Read reviews** – Look at both positive and negative reviews to gauge consistency. 5. **Ask for references** – A reputable guard or agency will happily provide references from past clients. 6. **Get a quote** – Compare rates, but remember that the cheapest option isn’t always the safest. If you let me know whether you’re looking for an individual guard or a security company, and what kind of environment you need protection for (home, office, event, etc.), I can give more tailored suggestions or even help you draft a request for proposals.
